Warranty: LED Flood Lights, LED Street Lights and Solar Street Lights shall carry the manufacture r's standard warranty or the warranty period specified in the GeM Bid, whichever is applicable. 7. Packing & Transportation: All items shall be properly packed to prevent damage during transpor tation and handling. No Substitution: No change in make, model, specification, wattage, size, capacity or type of mate rial shall be permitted without prior written approval of the Competent Authority. 12. Delivery: The material shall be delivered within the delivery period specified in the GeM Contract a t the designated consignee location. 14. Price: The quoted price shall include all costs required for complete delivery at the consignee locat ion, including packing, forwarding, transportation, loading/unloading and other incidental charges, e xcept taxes/duties required to be quoted separately. 15. Rejection: The purchaser reserves the right to reject material that is sub-standard, damaged, defe ctive, counterfeit, used, refurbished or not in conformity with the prescribed specifications. 16. Verification: The purchaser reserves the right to verify the authenticity of the manufacturer's certi ficates, BIS/ISI documents, warranty documents and other submitted documents from the concerne d manufacturer/issuing authority. 17. Compliance with GeM Conditions: The procurement shall be governed by the applicable GeM G eneral Terms & Conditions (GTC), Bid Conditions and prevailing Government procurement rules. In c ase of any inconsistency, the applicable GeM provisions shall prevail. 18. Suitable for Outdoor Use: The supplied electrical lighting equipment shall be suitable for outd oor installation and continuous operation under normal outdoor environmental condition s, including exposure to dust, rain, humidity and temperature variations. The equipment shall have a weather-resistant construction and suitable ingress protection (IP) rating as applicable t o the item, and shall be designed to ensure safe and reliable performance during outdoor use. .
